frozen_source_payload.authority: Figshare repository record supplied by the LocalMapper dataset authors

blind_row_selection_rule.reaction_field_split: Parse only the reactant field before the first reaction separator. The product field is prohibited until the complete 47-identity source-only selection is written and hash-sealed.
blind_row_selection_rule.source_component_rule: Retain every row with exactly two dot-separated parser-resolved source components and a globally unique map identity on every non-hydrogen atom.
blind_row_selection_rule.diene_rule: One component has exactly two non-aromatic mapped carbon-carbon double adjacencies. Their endpoint sets are disjoint and exactly one mapped carbon-carbon single adjacency joins one endpoint from each double adjacency, yielding one complete four-carbon conjugated path.
blind_row_selection_rule.alkene_rule: The other component has exactly one non-aromatic mapped carbon-carbon double adjacency.
blind_row_selection_rule.ordering: Retain all 47 qualifying identities in original file order without a row limit, random draw, favorable-only filter, named-product selector, yield threshold or post-outcome exclusion.
blind_row_selection_rule.postseal_generated_product_family: The product has one connected mapped carrier and exactly the same map inventory. Exactly two new cross-source-component adjacencies form one complete matching between the two outer diene carbons and the two alkene carbons; both matching orientations are generated. The two diene double adjacencies and alkene double adjacency each lose one multiplicity layer; the internal diene single adjacency gains one retained layer; every other mapped adjacency and multiplicity is unchanged.
postseal_targets: every favorable adverse absent malformed and unresolved selected row

native_arithmetic_boundary: No external numerical zero, signed, decimal, continuum or conventional structure inscription enters native forcing; structural absence is EmptyOne.
